XY series · DCR

Double Crisis

Released March 25, 2015 · 34 cards

Expanded

Double Crisis is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on March 25, 2015. It has 34 cards. It includes 22 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

15 illustrators worked on Double Crisis. Most cards: GAME FREAK inc. (4), Toyste Beach (4), 5ban Graphics (2), Akira Komayama (2), Hitoshi Ariga (2), kawayoo (2), Kouki Saitou (2), Masakazu Fukuda (2).
